package hybridreplan

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"log/slog"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type Clock interface{ Now() time.Time }

// SnapshotProcessor only obtains/checkpoints coherent observations. T20.2
// provides no evaluation or consequence-application dependency.
type SnapshotProcessor struct {
	Jobs       repository.HybridReplanning
	Students   domainservice.HybridStudentSnapshotService
	Clock      Clock
	LeaseTTL   time.Duration
	RetryDelay time.Duration
}

func (p SnapshotProcessor) ProcessNext(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if p.Jobs == nil || p.Students == nil || p.Clock == nil || p.LeaseTTL <= 0 || p.RetryDelay <= 0 {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	work, claimed, err := p.Jobs.ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, p.Clock.Now().UTC(), p.LeaseTTL)
	if err != nil || !claimed {
		return false, err
	}
	// One bounded lifetime belongs to this durable lease. A restarted worker can
	// only reclaim after expiry; its claim token fences this worker's checkpoint.
	workContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, p.LeaseTTL)
	defer cancel()
	fail := func(cause error) (bool, error) {
		releaseErr := p.Jobs.ReleaseHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, work, p.Clock.Now().UTC().Add(p.RetryDelay))
		return true, errors.Join(cause, releaseErr)
	}
	event := work.LatestEvent
	if domain.ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(event) != nil || work.StudentID != event.StudentID || work.LearningPathID != event.Data.LearningPathID || work.Generation < 1 || strings.TrimSpace(work.ClaimToken) == "" || !work.LeaseUntil.After(p.Clock.Now().UTC()) {
		return fail(domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	reason := "Committed Student planning state"
	if work.LocalReason != "" {
		if work.LocalReason != "OWNER_APPLICATION_STALE" {
			return fail(domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		reason = "Planner recovery after stale owner application"
	}
	request, err := domain.NormalizeHybridSnapshotRequest(domain.HybridSnapshotRequest{Targets: event.Data.Targets, TriggerContext: domain.HybridSnapshotTrigger{Kind: event.Data.TriggerKind, Reason: reason, CorrelationID: event.EventID}})
	if err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
		snapshot, readErr := p.Students.GetHybridPlanningSnapshot(workContext, work.StudentID, work.LearningPathID, request)
		if readErr != nil {
			return fail(readErr)
		}
		if err := domain.ValidateHybridPlanningSnapshot(snapshot, work.StudentID, work.LearningPathID, request); err != nil {
			return fail(err)
		}
		// This snapshot alone discovers the path's target set. If a concurrent path
		// revision introduces another target, refetch the entire expanded set; never
		// join old mastery/profile/path fragments into an invented observation.
		nextRequest, complete, unionErr := snapshotTargetUnion(request, snapshot)
		if unionErr != nil {
			return fail(unionErr)
		}
		if !complete {
			request = nextRequest
			continue
		}
		if !work.LeaseUntil.After(p.Clock.Now().UTC()) {
			return fail(domain.ErrConflict)
		}
		if _, err := p.Jobs.CheckpointHybridSnapshot(workContext, work, snapshot, domain.HybridReplanPolicyVersion); err != nil {
			return fail(err)
		}
		return true, nil
	}
	return fail(domain.ErrStateChanged)
}

func snapshotTargetUnion(request domain.HybridSnapshotRequest, snapshot domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot) (domain.HybridSnapshotRequest, bool, error) {
	targets := map[string]domain.HybridTargetRef{}
	identity := func(t domain.HybridTargetRef) string { return string(t.Type) + "\x00" + t.Key + "\x00" + t.Version }
	for _, target := range request.Targets {
		targets[identity(target)] = target
	}
	complete := true
	for _, target := range domain.HybridSnapshotTargets(snapshot) {
		key := identity(target)
		if _, present := targets[key]; !present {
			complete = false
			targets[key] = target
		}
	}
	if complete {
		return request, true, nil
	}
	request.Targets = make([]domain.HybridTargetRef, 0, len(targets))
	for _, target := range targets {
		request.Targets = append(request.Targets, target)
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeHybridSnapshotRequest(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HybridSnapshotRequest{}, false, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return normalized, false, nil
}

type SnapshotWorker struct {
	Processor    SnapshotProcessor
	PollInterval time.Duration
	Logger       *slog.Logger
}

func (w SnapshotWorker) Run(ctx context.Context) {
	interval := w.PollInterval
	if interval <= 0 {
		interval = time.Second
	}
	logger := w.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = slog.Default()
	}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for ctx.Err() == nil {
		processed, err := w.Processor.ProcessNext(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			logger.ErrorContext(ctx, "hybrid planning snapshot checkpoint failed", "error", err)
		}
		if processed && err == nil {
			continue
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
